quest.title: The Tree who Stands Alone
quest.description: You meet a very strange old man while in Mingyun Village...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Primogem x50, Liyue Shrine of Depths Key x1

dialogues.speaker: Exhortations of a dying man
dialogues.text: "...The tree who stands alone has no forest to call his home... But the sturdy rock has a heart of gold, unite and you shall share in its blessings... This fortune hereby made known unto you, I say: honor the will of your father..."

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Qing
dialogues.text: Oh no! What did I do to deserve this...

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Qing
dialogues.text: I finally managed to slip away while they weren't watching so that I could be first to get to the mine and find the treasure... But where did all these monsters come from!?

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Qing
dialogues.text: I'm done for...

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Cheng
dialogues.text: Hmph, lousy older brothers! All they care about is taking the best finds for themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Cheng
dialogues.text: And dad's losing it in his old age... either completely oblivious, or just happy to turn a blind eye...

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Cheng
dialogues.text: I don't think they've realized yet that the treasure's in the mine.

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Cheng
dialogues.text: I've gotta get my hands on it... and then get as far away from here as possible!

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Liang
dialogues.text: Hehehe... The treasure will be mine!

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Liang
dialogues.text: My brothers are such morons... They ran off after grasping a couple of lines thinking they'd figured it out. Hehehe...

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Liang
dialogues.text: Honor father's will? Bah! There was one line worth reading in that thing, and that was the part about the treasure being in the mine. Speaking of mine... Soon it will all be mine! Hehehe...

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Hong
dialogues.text: They've left... They've all left...

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Hong
dialogues.text: Yuan Qing, Yuan Liang, Yuan Cheng... You foolish children. You'll have to think a bit more carefully and look harder than you are doing now...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, look! It's those guys from earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Qing
dialogues.text: The tree who stands alone has no forest to call his home... Haha, it's true, you can't achieve anything by yourself...

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Cheng
dialogues.text: The splendid red autumnal leaves, part ways though there be no breeze... If I could take my brothers and father at their word...

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Liang
dialogues.text: The glorious red autumnal leaves, part ways on a passing breeze... The treasure... Lost everything, all because of the treasure...

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Hong
dialogues.text: Trees should blend their roots and shade, for that is where the home is made... Children, we're supposed to be a family...

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Hong
dialogues.text: You seriously thought I hid treasure in the mine? ... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Hong
dialogues.text: There is a treasure, though... Do you still remember the tree we planted together as a family when you were children?

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Hong
dialogues.text: I come here every year and put a little something inside, hoping that when you're older we can dig it out together.

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Hong
dialogues.text: And then use it to buy some treats and a bottle of wine... celebrate together, as a family... talk about the old times...

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Hong
dialogues.text: Oh children, my dear children...

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Hong
dialogues.text: The tree who stands alone has no forest to call his home...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Hong
dialogues.text: The splendid red autumnal leaves, parted ways though there be no breeze...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello! Excuse me!

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Hong
dialogues.text: The glorious red autumnal leaves, parted ways on a passing breeze...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why are they ignoring us?

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Hong
dialogues.text: Money... riches... It's all a farce. A farce, I say!

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Hong
dialogues.text: The further away from this village... the better...

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Hong
dialogues.text: If only we could start all over again... From the beginning...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, isn't the first half of this what that old guy was saying?
